algorithm.name: P3 fresh witness plus bounded reduction-forest memory order
algorithm.method: Fresh witness incumbent, then at most one graph-derived reduction-forest order if total online E0 calls remain below three; accept only strict official Makespan improvement. No per-case lookup or historical plan reuse.

offline_costs: Fresh witness full500 and its same-plan no-L2 pair were separate earlier experiments. Forest two-graph mechanism test used two constructors and four external official E0; no previous result substitutes any cell here. Fixed source has 184 passed tests, one explicit E0 opt-in skipped, and ten relevant tests passed after the final guard.

parameters.selection: strictly smaller official Makespan than fresh witness incumbent

memory.scope: sum of process-group RSS / Windows job WorkingSetSize; sampled tripwire, not OS hard limit; shared pages may be counted more than once
